verdict.rationale: Appwrite Functions can be triggered by scheduled executions, server events, and webhooks, enabling automations that run autonomously in the background without direct user action (appwrite-docs-9, appwrite-docs-28). This is a first-party documented core feature of the platform's serverless Functions product. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of scheduling reliability, detail on monitoring/retry behavior for autonomous runs, and any AI-agent-specific orchestration of these automations.
